affected_component: primary conductor and crossarm, PRD1201 mainline section 2
corrective_action_plan: Re-prioritise HFTD Tier 3 vegetation findings to complete within 14 days; remove the hazard oak.
failure_cause_description: Decayed valley oak limb failed under wet snow and 60 mph gusts and fell across the primary; the limb had been flagged by vegetation patrol INS-2024-VG-1210 on 10 Dec 2024.
repair_action_taken: Limb removed, two phases spliced, crossarm replaced on P-1201-114.
root_cause_analysis_findings: Known vegetation hazard with 4 ft clearance in HFTD Tier 3 was scheduled for trim after the storm date (WO-2024121003, 20 Jan 2025). Deferred mitigation was the root cause.

affected_component: H1 bushing and HV winding insulation
corrective_action_plan: Add infrared hotspot >20 C rise as an automatic trigger for replacement within 30 days; review loading of other 25-50 kVA units on the class.
failure_cause_description: Overheated H1 bushing connection degraded the HV winding insulation until an internal turn-to-turn fault ruptured the tank gasket.
repair_action_taken: Transformer replaced with a 50 kVA unit; cutout and arrester replaced; oil spill remediated.
root_cause_analysis_findings: The hotspot and oil leak found by infrared inspection INS-2024-DT-0412 (18 Nov 2024) were the precursors; replacement WO-2024112001 had been deferred. Sustained loading above 90% accelerated insulation ageing.

affected_component: phase B conductor and insulator string at span 52
corrective_action_plan: Extend LiDAR strike-tree analysis to 200 ft beyond the right-of-way edge in HFTD Tier 3.
failure_cause_description: Wind-thrown pine top contacted phase B at span 52 inside HFTD Tier 3.
repair_action_taken: Tree removed, insulator string replaced, line re-energized after patrol.
root_cause_analysis_findings: Tree was outside the right-of-way (strike tree); not on the hazard-tree list.

failure_cause_description: Vehicle struck pole P-3102-087; pole snapped at ground line.

affected_component: 200 A load-break elbows in pad-mount enclosure
failure_cause_description: Flood water inside the pad-mount enclosure tracked across the elbows.
repair_action_taken: Vault pumped, elbows and bushings replaced.

failure_cause_description: Lightning surge exceeded arrester energy rating; arrester failed shorted and blew fuse F1.
Lateral load of 118% of fuse rating during a 41 C heat event melted the fuse link.
Water treeing in 1987-vintage XLPE riser cable caused an insulation breakdown.
repair_action_taken: Riser termination and 30 m of cable replaced.
